# Function and module registry

**Generated by `cargo xtask registry` from the source code. Do not edit by hand**: CI fails when it is out of date.
Before writing anything new, search this file (REUSE → EXTEND → REFACTOR → CREATE NEW, see CLAUDE.md).
An item's purpose is the first sentence of its `///` comment; its status is Implemented unless that sentence says otherwise.
Tests are in each file's `mod tests`.
